path.data-description: The translucent handle, lit from within. R960 ISM table 108: green - a valid source is connected and the supply is operational; blinking amber - a problem with the supply; not illuminated - no power; blinking green - firmware being updated; five green blinks at 4 Hz then off - a mismatch with the other supply.
